# Welcome to Dallas Guide for Incoming GLPers

Welcome to the PMG GLP Program! This guide is designed to help you transition into life in Dallas. WILL NEED TO UPDATE MORE LATER USING IN-DEPTH DETAILS

# Choosing Your Neighborhood

## Inner Loop

The PMG office sits in Uptown, so the closer you live to McKinney Avenue, the shorter your commute — and usually the higher your rent.

## Inner-Loop Options

| Neighborhood | Vibe and what's nearby | Average 1BR rent* |
|---|---|---|
| [Uptown](https://www.google.com/search?q=uptown+dallas){target="_blank"} | Walkable to the office, McKinney Avenue trolley, Katy Trail, and nightlife. | $2,400–$2,800+ |
| [Knox–Henderson](https://www.google.com/search?q=knox+henderson+dallas){target="_blank"} | Trendy shopping and dining, about 10 minutes from the office. | ~$1,800 |
| [Oak Lawn](https://www.google.com/search?q=oak+lawn+dallas){target="_blank"} | Residential feel with access to Katy Trail and Turtle Creek. | ~$1,900–$2,200 |
| [Deep Ellum](https://www.google.com/search?q=deep+ellum+dallas){target="_blank"} | Arts, murals, restaurants, and live music east of Downtown. | ~$1,950 |
| [Bishop Arts](https://www.google.com/search?q=bishop+arts+dallas){target="_blank"} | Walkable shops, restaurants, and patios in a historic district. | ~$1,300–$1,500 |
| [Lower Greenville](https://www.google.com/search?q=lower+greenville+dallas){target="_blank"} | Bars, restaurants, and a young-professional crowd near Lakewood and SMU. | ~$1,700 |

## Suburban Options

| Area | Vibe and what's nearby | Average 1BR rent* | Commute to Uptown |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Richardson](https://www.google.com/search?q=richardson+tx){target="_blank"} | Quiet, good value, and close to UT Dallas and the Telecom Corridor. | ~$1,300–$1,400 | 25–30 min via US-75 |
| [Addison](https://www.google.com/search?q=addison+tx){target="_blank"} | Large restaurant and bar scene along Belt Line Road. | ~$1,450–$1,550 | 20–25 min via DNT |
| [Plano](https://www.google.com/search?q=plano+tx){target="_blank"} | Family-friendly, with major corporate offices and Legacy West. | ~$1,350–$1,450 | 30–35 min via DNT or US-75 |
| [Frisco](https://www.google.com/search?q=frisco+tx){target="_blank"} | Newer development, sports venues, restaurants, and retail. | ~$1,300–$1,400 | 35–45 min via DNT |
| [Las Colinas](https://www.google.com/search?q=las+colinas+irving){target="_blank"} | Canals, trails, corporate campuses, and quick access to DFW Airport. | ~$1,550–$1,750 | 20–25 min via I-35E |

*Rough averages as of mid-2026. Rents vary by season, building, and current availability.*

::: {.callout-tip}
### Rule of Thumb
The closer you live to Uptown and McKinney Avenue, the higher the rent but the easier the commute. Richardson, Plano, and Frisco can cost less but require a daily highway commute.
:::

## Apartment Fees

| Fee | Typical Cost |
|-----|--------------|
| Application | $50–75 |
| Parking | $100–200 |
| Valet Trash | $20 |
